The average grain size of the investigated alloys increases from 14 to 28 pm in the temperature range from 1050 to 1150°C.
The matrix becomes softer after solution treatment at 1050°C compared with the value of HV~,~ 220 without solution.
The microhardness of the matrix is approximately HV~.~ 144 after solution treatment at 1050°C.
With increasing solution temperature, the microhardness increases gradually, and is approximately HV~.~ 260 at 1150°C.

The increasing of the microhardness is mainly because of the solid-solution strengthening induced by the dissolution of Mo.

mechanisms.name: carbide dissolution controlled by local-equilibrium diffusion
